name: ridge_truncated
title: Ridge truncated by an irregular boundary
description: An asymmetric ridge whose lower contours run off an irregular six-sided boundary. The open contours are cut exactly on the boundary ring so the constrained TIN ends at the demesne edge instead of extrapolating past it.

meta.z_datum: asset-local datum (0 m at the recipe base plane)

provenance.derivation: terrain raster written from the analytic surface, re-parsed, then marching-squares level sets clipped exactly to boundary and holes; rings split at contour meeting points so constraints are representable
